cues.text: A 29-year-old man has pain in his left neck and shoulder.
He fell from his motorbike at high speed.
His arm was forced away from his body: a forced abduction injury.
Imaging shows an upper brachial plexus lesion.
Now look at the lateral cord of the brachial plexus, shown here in green.
One of its branches is the musculocutaneous nerve.
So the musculocutaneous nerve is the branch of the lateral cord we are looking for.
Remember: the lateral cord gives the musculocutaneous nerve.
